recognize_zh: 脂肪性骨髓中，大量小型細胞呈棕色細胞膜染色，散布於脂肪細胞間的間質、彼此間距較寬，呈毛細胞白血病典型的間質性 B 細胞浸潤；影像雖未標示抗體，依描述應為 CD20。
features: Numerous small to medium cells with strong brown membranous/cytoplasmic staining in an interstitial pattern between adipocytes
Positive cells widely spaced, singly and in loose strands, without forming discrete nodules
Bony trabecula edge at the upper right without paratrabecular aggregates
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a hypocellular, fat-rich bone marrow core biopsy highlights numerous small to medium cells with membranous positivity, arranged as a widely spaced interstitial infiltrate between adipocytes. The positive cells do not form discrete nodules or paratrabecular aggregates, and negative hematopoietic cells are interspersed. The marker is not labeled on the image but, per the case description, corresponds to CD20. Findings are consistent with interstitial involvement by hairy cell leukemia; the extent of infiltration is better appreciated on immunostain than on H&E.

ddx.vs: SMZL shows nodular and intrasinusoidal CD20+ infiltrates and is annexin A1, CD25 and cyclin D1 negative.
MCL forms nodular or paratrabecular aggregates of CD5+, strongly cyclin D1+/SOX11+ cells.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with residual lymphoid cells
ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow contains only scattered polytypic B and T cells rather than a dense CD20+ interstitial infiltrate.
